docs.title: Dark Tech Launch
docs.text:
Dark Tech Launch
16:9 Apple/Linear-inspired SaaS launch: obsidian surfaces, specular glow, 2.5D camera glides, beat-synced pulses and floating UI frames.
# Dark Tech Launch — 16:9 product-launch grammar

An obsidian launch system for SaaS and hardware reveals. It borrows the restraint of Apple keynotes and the precision of Linear's product films: one claim, one product frame, one luminous accent. Motion is 2.5D and deliberate; nothing orbits, nothing bounces.

## Pacing

Hook **1.5–2.5s**, body **2.5–4.5s**, outro **2.5–4s**, static hold ceiling **4s**. Trim silence at **200ms**; keep short **80ms J-cuts** and **160ms L-cuts** for tight narration. Half the cuts should land on a beat.

## Type & captions

Ultra Display for product claims, set in sentence case at generous size. Ultra Sans for captions in **3–6 word** chunks with the active word shifted to mint. Mono labels carry specs and timestamps. Captions sit at **70–84% height**, inside the 16:9 title-safe box.

## Motion

`easeInOutCubic` glides with a **1.00 → 1.10** punch-in ceiling. Two motion-blur samples keep camera moves cinematic. Feature badges float on a 2.5D plane with 12px parallax, and glow pulses sync to the beat — not to wall-clock time.

## Color & texture

Obsidian `#07090D`, raised surface `#0E131C`, ice white `#F2F6FF`, steel `#8FA0B8`, mint `#7CF5C7`, electric blue `#4F7CFF`. Grade +0.08 exposure, +16% contrast, a −0.08 cooling shift and a **0.30 vignette**. Grain 0.03, halation 0.18 — specular, not smoky.

## Sound

**−14 LUFS**, **90–124 BPM**. Hero → riser, reveal → whoosh, accent → chime, stat → pop. Duck music **12 dB** under voice.

## Non-negotiables

No rainbow gradients. No orbiting logos. No HUD clutter. No unlabeled benchmark charts. If a UI frame appears, it must show a real interface state with readable labels.

docs.title: Kinetic Editorial
docs.text:
Kinetic Editorial
16:9 Vox-style documentary explainer: measured pacing, warm paper palette, underline captions and SVG path-draw callouts.
# Kinetic Editorial — 16:9 explainer grammar

A documentary explainer system in the Vox tradition: argument first, texture second. Warm paper, charcoal type, one vermilion accent. Chapters are written, not decorated — every card makes a claim before it shows a graphic.

## Pacing

- Hook ASL **1.5–2.5s**, body ASL **2.5–4.5s**, outro **3–5s**. Let a viewer finish a thought; never let a frame sit past **4.5s**.
- Silence trim at **220ms**, J-cuts **240ms**, L-cuts **300ms**. Audio edits are softer than the shortform system.
- Beat-snap target **45%** — cut for argument structure, not for every kick drum.

## Type & captions

Ultra Display carries chapter titles and pull quotes. Ultra Sans handles captions in **3–6 word** chunks, title case, with a **vermilion underline** on the active word. The caption band sits at **72–86% height**, inside the 16:9 six-percent title-safe perimeter.

## Motion

Slow, confident moves: `easeInOutSine` dominant, punch-ins capped at **1.08**, two motion-blur samples for subtle camera blur. SVG callout arrows draw with a dash offset before the stat lands. Chapter cards rule in from the left margin.

## Color & texture

Paper `#F6F0E6`, aged surface `#E8DFCE`, ink `#1C1B18`, muted pencil `#6A645A`, vermilion `#E4572E`, deep teal `#2F5D62`. Grade adds a warm +0.12 temperature and a light 0.12 vignette. Grain **0.06**, halftone **0.10** at micro scale — printed matter, not a filter.

## Sound

**−14 LUFS**, **80–110 BPM** understated bed. Chapter → chime, data callout → pop, transitions → soft whoosh, UI accents → click. Duck music **14 dB** under narration.

## Non-negotiables

No neon startup gradients. No caption walls. No whip pans. No stock imagery of handshakes or boardrooms. If a graphic does not advance the argument, cut it.

docs.title: Punchy Shortform
docs.text:
Punchy Shortform
9:16 retention-first shortform: sub-2s hooks, punch-in zooms, active-word pill captions and hard-cut sound design.
# Punchy Shortform — 9:16 retention grammar

A shortform system built for the first three seconds. Hooks are blunt, type is enormous, and every cut earns the next hundred milliseconds. Use it for product demos, talking-head edits, list videos and stat-driven explainers that must survive the TikTok / Reels / Shorts feed.

## Pacing

- Hook average shot length: **0.9–1.6s**. Land a claim, a number or a contradiction before the viewer's thumb moves.
- Body ASL: **1.6–2.8s**. Cut on the beat, never coast past **2.8s** of static frame.
- Trim silence at **160ms**, keep **120ms J-cuts** and **180ms L-cuts** so audio leads the picture.
- Aim for **65%** of cuts landing within ±100ms of an onset.

## Type & captions

Display type is Ultra Display (700), tight tracking, sentence meaning over decoration. Captions are Ultra Sans 700, **2–4 words per chunk**, uppercase, with an **active-word pill** in accent yellow. The caption band lives at **62–76% height** on 9:16 — fully above the bottom 22% platform UI and clear of the right 15% rail.

## Motion

Punch-ins run **1.00 → 1.14** with `easeOutExpo`; the accent uses `easeOutBack` for a decisive overshoot. Motion blur is sampled **4×** per frame so zooms read like a real camera, not a CSS transition. Camera drift stays under 18px.

## Color & texture

Obsidian `#0B0D12`, raised surfaces `#151A23`, warm white `#F7F5EF`, muted blue-grey `#9AA4B2`, signal yellow `#FFD447`, alert coral `#FF5A5F`. Grade adds +0.12 contrast, +12% saturation and a restrained 0.18 vignette. Film grain 0.045, halation 0.12 — texture, not haze.

## Sound

Target **−14 LUFS** with a **110–150 BPM** bed. Hook → sub-hit, transition → whoosh-fast, accent → ui-click, pop-ins → pop. Duck music **11 dB** under voice.

## Non-negotiables

No slow logo stings. No talking head held past 2.8s. No captions under the platform rail. No decorative gradient washes — color comes from the palette, type and footage.

docs.title: 01-approval-gate
docs.text:
# 01 — Pre-Production Approval Gate

- Every edit/build must begin with `workspace/plan.json` (strict schema) and `PLAN.md`.
- `ultra preprod-render` must emit a real moodboard.png and storyboard*.png using bundled fonts on every render tier.
- Show both images to the user and wait for explicit approval. Self-approval is forbidden.
- `ultra approve --by user` writes `approval.json` containing SHA-256(plan.json + ultra.json if present).
- `ultra build` and `ultra render` fail when approval is missing, revoked, or the hash changed.
- `--skip-approval` exists only for automated unit tests; never use it in a user-facing delivery.

docs.title: 02-anti-slop-motion
docs.text:
# 02 — Anti-slop motion

- Every cut must land on a beat, a word, or a measured hold; no random float.
- Hooks resolve inside the style hook window; never open with a slow logo sting.
- Punch-ins stay inside the style range; combine camera moves, never stack competing zooms.
- Captions use active-word emphasis only; no full-sentence rainbow karaoke.
- Palette colors come from DESIGN.md/plan.json only. No stock gradients, no template icons.
- Grain, halation and halftone are texture, not haze: keep them under the style opacity caps.
- Run the lint: clipping, contrast, palette, overlap and social safe-zone defects are release blockers.

docs.title: 03-zero-hallucination
docs.text:
# 03 — Zero hallucination

- Never mention a file, asset, font, style or artifact that is not on disk. `ultra guard` is the arbiter.
- Never write placeholder copy into scenes or captions (Lorem ipsum, TBD, INSERT TEXT, [YOUR ...]).
- Verify claims with `ffprobe`, `build/verify-report.json`, `build/delivery-manifest.json` and CI logs.
- If a gate fails, report the failing check and next command; do not claim success.
- Long chats: run `ultra status --json` and `ultra context-pack --stage <stage>` before acting.

docs.title: 04-4k-and-editable-delivery
docs.text:
# 04 — 4K and editable delivery

- Iterate with `ultra build --proxy` (max 1280px) and verify the proxy. Draft speed never changes the delivery target.
- Master with `ultra render --4k`; output must be exact 3840x2160 / 2160x3840 / 2160x2160, CFR yuv420p H.264 High@L5.1, AAC 48 kHz stereo 320k, -14 LUFS, +faststart.
- `hybrid` is the default 4K strategy: high-quality lanczos + accurate rounding + full chroma + subtle unsharp; `native` requires a 4K build. The strategy is logged in `build/delivery-manifest.json`.
- `ultra export-project` must produce FCPXML 1.10, OTIO JSON, project.ultra.json, DESIGN.md/Motion.md/PLAN.md, assets/scenes/fonts/motifs/grade, captions and a zero-CDN index.html — all with relative paths and CRC-verified zip.
- `ultra guard --stage delivery` must pass before any delivery claim.

docs.title: SKILL
docs.text:
# Clone Reference Skill

1. Probe the reference; plan the hook/body/outro with measured ASL, cuts, palettes and sound.
2. `ultra plan-init --mode clone --aspect <ref aspect>`; build a truthful storyboard and mood board.
3. Wait for approval; `ultra approve --by user`.
4. Assets: native tools / synth-audio / 3D graphs; `ultra validate-assets`.
5. `ultra build --proxy` -> `ultra verify <ref.mp4>`; patch or `ultra ralph auto-fix` until stutterEvents 0 and lint/style pass.
6. `ultra render --4k` -> `ultra export-project` -> `ultra guard --stage delivery`.

docs.title: SKILL
docs.text:
# Edit In Style Skill

1. `ultra status --json`; `ultra style-list`; choose `--style <slug>`.
2. `ultra raw-probe my_video.mp4 --style <slug> --aspect <aspect>`.
3. `ultra captions-align` from SRT/VTT/word JSON or script + envelope.
4. `ultra plan-init --mode edit-in-style --style <slug>`; storyboard the sourceClip trims, punch-ins, captions and overlays. Show preprod PNGs; wait; approve.
5. `ultra build --proxy` -> `ultra verify --style <slug>` or `ultra ralph auto-fix` until style compliance passes (>=90 match).
6. `ultra render --4k` -> `ultra export-project` -> `ultra guard --stage delivery`.

docs.title: SKILL
docs.text:
# Extract Style Skill

1. `ultra style-probe <1-10 videos> --out workspace/style-probe --hook-window 5`.
2. Map-Reduce the 8 style groups into style.json (strict schema), STYLE.md, 2+ deterministic motifs and 2-8 exemplars.
3. `ultra style-validate <dir>` until exit 0.
4. `ultra style-export <dir> --out build/<slug>-style-pack.zip`.
5. Deliver only the validated zip; Qoder imports it with `ultra style-import <zip> --repack`.

docs.title: SKILL
docs.text:
# Pre-Production Storyboard Skill

Use before any editing/building.

1. `ultra plan-init --mode clone|edit-in-style [--style <slug>] [--aspect 9:16|16:9|1:1] [--resolution 4k|1080p]`.
2. Replace the template shot cards with the real measured concept, palette, type hierarchy, camera direction, caption text, engine and SFX.
3. `ultra preprod-render` -> `build/preprod/moodboard.png` + `storyboard*.png`.
4. Inspect both PNGs; verify palette contrast, typography, shot timings and safe zones.
5. Show them to the user, WAIT, then `ultra approve --by user`.
6. If the plan changes: rerun preprod-render, re-show, re-approve.

docs.title: asset-producer
docs.text:
# Role — Asset Producer

Stage: assets. Inputs: approved plan, ultra.json, assets-todo.json.
Outputs: workspace/assets/*, assets.manifest.json, synthesized WAVs.
Commands: ultra asset-plan --host chatgpt; ultra synth-audio --from-assets; ultra validate-assets.
Contract: every referenced asset must exist and pass alpha/XML/duration checks. Parallelizable with director once plan.json is stable.

docs.title: director
docs.text:
# Role — Director

Stage: preprod. Inputs: reference/raw footage, user intent, top RAG hits.
Outputs: workspace/plan.json, PLAN.md, build/preprod/moodboard.png, storyboard*.png, approval.json.
Commands: ultra probe / raw-probe; ultra rag query; ultra plan-init; ultra preprod-render; ultra approve --by user.
Contract: never build before explicit user approval. Can run in parallel with asset-producer only after the plan exists.

docs.title: mastering-engineer
docs.text:
# Role — Mastering Engineer

Stage: master/delivery. Inputs: verified draft, build manifest, delivery target.
Outputs: build/ultra-final.mp4 (4K), delivery-manifest.json, editable-project/ + zip.
Commands: ultra render --4k; ultra export-project; ultra guard --stage delivery.
Contract: exact 4K dims, CFR yuv420p, AAC 48k stereo, +faststart, valid FCPXML/OTIO/zip; guard must exit 0.

docs.title: motion-builder
docs.text:
# Role — Motion Builder

Stage: build. Inputs: ultra.json, captions.json, assets, approved plan.
Outputs: build/draft.mp4, build/build-manifest.json, build/scenes/*.
Commands: ultra validate-spec; ultra build --proxy.
Contract: deterministic CFR, no banned transitions, captions inside safe zones. Runs after director + asset-producer handoff.

docs.title: qa-critic
docs.text:
# Role — QA Critic

Stage: verify/fix. Inputs: draft.mp4, audit frames, verify targets.
Outputs: build/verify-report.json, patch history, ralph-state.json/history.
Commands: ultra verify; ultra ralph auto-fix; ultra patch; ultra guard --stage verify.
Contract: stutterEvents must be 0; lint criticals 0; style compliance and match >= 90. Evidence only, no vibes.
